findings.title: A date with a short year is read as a year of the first century
findings.affected: `src/core/dates.ts`; every command that takes dates, and every program that uses the core.
findings.expected: an error. The documents promise `DD-MM-YYYY` or `YYYY-MM-DD` with a four-digit year.
findings.observed: `23-09-26` was accepted as year 23, month 9, day 26, and `5-01-02` as year 5. The year of the second form could have one to four digits.
findings.impact: a person who types a short year gets a shift that differs from the one for the intended date, with no warning. The phrase can still be restored with the same short spelling, but not with the full date the person remembers.
findings.evidence: the probe output; `test/core.test.ts`, "needs a four-digit year in both spellings".
findings.recommendedFix: require four digits in both forms.
findings.requiredVerification: short years are refused; `0026` gives the year 26.

findings.title: Invented email and website addresses can belong to a real company
findings.affected: `src/export/card-identities.ts`, `src/export/card-settings.ts`; every business card with invented details.
findings.expected: invented contacts are decoration and point to nobody.
findings.observed: the addresses had the form `contact@<company>.com` and `<company>.com`. Some of these domains are registered by real companies.
findings.impact: a printed card could name the mailbox and website of a real company. No secret is involved. Details supplied by the person are printed as given.
findings.recommendedFix: use the `.example` domain, which RFC 2606 reserves for examples.
findings.requiredVerification: every invented address ends in `.example`; supplied addresses are unchanged.

findings.title: A sheet size together with `--cards-dir` gives cards of the sheet size
findings.reproduction: ask for separate cards with the page size `a6`.
findings.expected: the page size decides the result: `wallet` and `business` give separate cards, `a6` and `a4` give one sheet. A request that contradicts this is refused.
findings.observed: eight separate cards were produced, each on a page of A6 size.
findings.impact: an unexpected result that no document describes. No data is lost.
findings.evidence: the probe output; `test/card-page-sizes.test.ts`, "refuses separate cards of a sheet size".
findings.recommendedFix: refuse separate cards for a sheet size. `--cards-dir` only names the folder for separate cards.
findings.requiredVerification: the request fails with a message that names the card sizes; a card size and no size still work.

findings.title: Renderer errors name command-line options and the wrong text
findings.reproduction: from another program, ask for a QR code on separate cards; or supply a name of 100 characters.
findings.expected: a message that every host can show and that names the text which does not fit.
findings.observed: the first message advised `--page-size` and `--card-qr`, which a program with a form does not have. The second said that the "Study heading" is too long, although the supplied text was the name.
findings.impact: confusing messages outside the command line. No secret is involved.
findings.recommendedFix: word the renderer messages without option names, and pass a label for the text being fitted.
findings.requiredVerification: no renderer message contains `--`; the message for a long text names that text.

findings.title: Audit records cite commits that `main` no longer contains
findings.reproduction: look up the three commits cited in the records with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> main`.
findings.expected: a reader can open the reviewed snapshot, or is told why not.
findings.observed: none of the three commits is on `main`. The history was rewritten so that every document exists in one version, which gave every commit a new identifier.
findings.impact: the records look broken, although the reviewed source is still in the history.
findings.recommendedFix: explain the rewrite in the index and in both reports. Leave the JSON records as they are, because they are retained evidence.
findings.requiredVerification: the index has the explanation and each report links to it.

findings.title: The input size limits are not documented
findings.reproduction: search the documents for the limits.
findings.observed: 1 MiB for text and 16 MiB and 4096 pixels for a QR image were enforced but described nowhere, after the document that described them was removed.
findings.impact: a refusal of large input has no explanation in the documents.
findings.requiredVerification: the README values equal the constants in code.

findings.title: The help and the README omit recovery options
findings.reproduction: compare the options known to the parser with the help and the README.
findings.observed: the help lacked `--network`, `--bitcoin-profile`, `--account`, `--branch` and `--index`; the README lacked `--max-results` and `--progress-every`.
findings.impact: the options work but cannot be discovered.
findings.requiredVerification: the comparison finds no undocumented option.

findings.title: Page sizes, the millimetre unit and a colour conversion are duplicated
findings.affected: the layout and artwork modules under `src/export/`; `src/export/card-session.ts`.
findings.reproduction: search for the page dimensions, the `MM` constant and the `hsv` function.
findings.observed: the table of page dimensions existed in four files, `MM` in three and `hsv` in two. The card session had one line that could never run.
findings.impact: a change of a page size must be repeated in four places; a missed place gives pages of different sizes.
findings.evidence: search result; `test/card-page-sizes.test.ts`, "knows the size of every page in both orientations".
findings.recommendedFix: `pageDimensions` in `card-settings.ts`, one `MM`, a shared `color-math.ts`; replace the dead line with an explicit check.
findings.requiredVerification: one definition remains and the renders are unchanged.

findings.title: The compact sheet layout cannot be reached through the program
findings.reproduction: follow the callers of `collectionSheetLayout` for the `wallet` and `business` sizes.
findings.expected: code that the program can reach, or no such code.
findings.observed: since card sizes give separate cards, `renderCards` never asks for a sheet of a card size. Only tests that call a template renderer directly reach the compact branch.
findings.impact: code that must be maintained and tested without being used.
findings.recommendedFix: remove the compact branch and its tests, or state why it is kept.
findings.requiredVerification: the sheet tests pass without the branch.
findings.correction: 2026-09-29. The finding was wrong. The QR card of one Shamir share is offered in every size, and in the business size it is printed as a compact sheet, for example with `--card-layout qr --page-size business`. The review followed the path of ordinary cards only. Nothing was removed; the code now names this use in a comment, and `test/card-page-sizes.test.ts`, "prints the QR card of a share as a compact sheet of the business size", proves it.

informationalNotes: The PDF libraries `pdf-lib` and `@pdf-lib/fontkit` had their last release in 2022. No advisory is known, and they only process files that MnemoCode itself creates. Watch for advisories.
The main function of the command-line program has 174 lines and the sheet layout 115. Splitting them would make them easier to read; no defect follows from their length.

limitations: The reviewed parts keep secrets out of error messages and open no connection. The defects found were a date that was accepted in a form the documents exclude, unclear results and messages at the edge of the card interface, and documents that lagged behind the code.

This record does not cover the Shamir share engine, the recovery checks, image export, the reproducible build, or other platforms. The probe scripts were temporary and are not retained, so the probes can be repeated only through the regression tests named above. The reviewer also wrote the fixes; no second reviewer checked them. This is not a security certification.
